metadata.name: aireg-publish
metadata.description: Publish a skill or agent to a registry, or release a new version of one, including an edit made to an installed copy. Use when asked to publish, share, contribute or release a skill or agent, send an edit to an installed skill back to its registry, update one that is already in a registry, publish a project's skills from CI, or fix what registry validation reports.
